starts.name: dead-horses
starts.desc: About 50 ft along the trail: two dead horses with black-feathered arrows, blocking the path (Gundren and Sildar's).

starts.name: goblins-one-side
starts.desc: Two goblins hide in the thickets on one side of the trail and shoot when someone examines the horses.

starts.name: goblins-other-side
starts.desc: Two more goblins hide on the other side of the trail.

starts.name: goblin-trail
starts.desc: The goblins' trail leads away from the ambush toward the Cragmaw hideout.
